source.note: Search summary (results: OnTheSnow overview, Wikipedia, Powder trail-map breakdown, Uncover Colorado): 3,741 skiable acres over six peaks, vertical 3,666 ft (consistent with Piste's 1,118 m), 23 lifts (2 gondolas, 1 high-speed six-seat, 8 high-speed quad, 4 triple and 2 double chairs, 6 surface lifts), 184 trails; 12% beginner / 38% intermediate / 41% advanced / 9% expert. Fish Creek Canyon terrain is served by the Mahogany Ridge Express. Season not stated.

character: A large resort on Mount Werner just outside the ranching town of Steamboat Springs in north-west Colorado, known for extensive tree skiing and dry snow. It is far from Denver, so most visitors fly into Hayden or plan a long drive.
learning: Reference note: first-timers are now usually sent to Greenhorn Ranch, a mid-mountain learning area with its own surface lifts reached by the gondola; lessons run through the resort ski and ride school. Confirm the setup and lesson products for 2026-27.

source.note: Search summary of 2026-27 opening-date roundups (Powder, "Ikon Pass Reveals Ski Resort Opening Dates for 2026-27 Season"; Freeskier; Unofficial Networks, 10 and 17 Sep 2026). Conditions permitting — confirm on the resort site. The official steamboat.com homepage (2026-10-03) shows a "WINTER SCHEDULED OPENING DAY" countdown (01 months, 02 weeks, 03 days, 19 hours at fetch time) without printing the date; that countdown is consistent with Nov. 21, 2026.

season.notes: 2026-27: planned opening Nov. 21, 2026 per the Ikon opening-date roundups (other sources disagree — see research conflicts). Closing not recorded: an Uncover Colorado roundup lists Apr. 4, 2027, but the same roundup gives a conflicting Nov. 20 opening, so it is not stored as announced. Steamboat announced its 2025-26 closing date after a dry winter (9News, 2026; date not captured).

prices.note: 2026-27 peak (ceiling) adult day price from a third-party roundup; dynamic pricing. An undated OnTheSnow listing (earlier search summary) showed $199 weekday / $279 weekend.

source.note: TownLift (Sep 4, 2026, read 2026-10-03): "Deer Valley's $349 puts it ahead of Steamboat at $344" on the 2026-27 peak-price list.
